name: Ruthless Grace: Mafia Queen
overview: In her past life, Scarlett Whitmore ruled the underworld. Now she wakes up as the discarded heiress of the family that betrayed her. Armed with ruthless instincts and a fake marriage to Theodore Vaughn, the one man she once considered an enemy, she takes back everything that was stolen. And the more they fight side by side, the harder it is to deny what fate keeps bringing back.
